title: Hiragana Foundations
oneSentenceGoal: Build working hiragana recognition and reading through sound practice, row review, and simple real words.
runtimeNotes: Adapted from effective worksheet patterns: chart reference, repeated row practice, reading recall, and real-word reinforcement.
These lessons are meant to be short, repeatable practice chunks rather than one giant alphabet dump.

sublevels.title: Vowels and First Words
sublevels.playerOutcome: Recognize the vowel row and read a few very short hiragana words.

components.goal: Introduce the five vowel sounds.
components.masteryRule: all 5 items must be completed once
components.retryBehavior: not applicable

components.goal: Choose the hiragana that matches the sound.
components.masteryRule: all items must be answered correctly
components.retryBehavior: missed items go to the back of the current component queue

components.goal: Read the hiragana back as a sound.
components.masteryRule: all items must be answered correctly
components.retryBehavior: missed items go to the back of the current component queue
